summary: WF Holding Ltd, a Malaysian swim-equipment manufacturer listed on the NYSE, filed a routine Form 6-K containing its interim financial statements for the period ended June 30, 2026, plus subsequent-event disclosures. Items referenced include a standby equity purchase agreement and placement agency agreement dated July 30, 2026, and a July 10, 2026 related-party transaction involving LYC and Lew Capital, alongside ordinary related-party balances and prior-year IPO and private-placement references. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, divestiture, or forced management change is disclosed. This is an ordinary semi-annual foreign-private-issuer reporting filing; no deal terms are stated.
